summary: IDS feed s185_triple is degraded: 83.3% encrypted traffic exceeds 60% IDS tolerance, VLAN 20 is missing (48% untagged), and 9.1% TCP packet loss detected. IDS requires full payload and both VLANs 10/20 for complete detection.

findings.root_cause: 83.3% of bytes are encrypted (threshold 60% for this IDS). Traffic is predominantly TLS/encrypted without broker-side decryption or selective bypass, leaving IDS with no cleartext payload to inspect.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS is blind to payload-based signatures and anomaly detection for ~83% of traffic; malware, C2, and exploit detection coverage severely reduced despite needing full payload.

recommended_fix.why: IDS needs cleartext to detect threats; decrypting relevant TLS at the broker (or steering encrypted flows to a decrypt-capable path) brings encrypted share below 60% tolerance while respecting privacy policy.

findings.root_cause: Required VLAN 20 not seen on feed; 48% of packets are untagged. Indicates VLAN tags stripped by TAP/SPAN or packet broker (trunk misconfigured as access, or broker set to strip tags) before delivery to IDS.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS loses segmentation context and misses all VLAN 20 traffic; required VLANs are [10,20] so ~50% of intended coverage is absent, breaking VLAN-based policies and detection for that segment.

recommended_fix.why: Preserving 802.1Q tags and forwarding both VLANs 10 and 20 to the IDS restores required visibility and allows correct VLAN-aware detection.

findings.root_cause: 9.1% of TCP packets (264/2900) show gaps/retransmission holes, well above 1% threshold. Pattern indicates packet broker buffer exhaustion or SPAN oversubscription dropping packets before IDS, not IDS overload (tool_overload healthy).
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS suffers incomplete TCP stream reassembly, missed flows and evasion risk; 9% loss causes false negatives and broken detection for stateful signatures requiring both directions and full payload.

recommended_fix.why: Distributing load via flow-aware load balancing (or filtering irrelevant traffic) prevents broker drops and keeps loss below 1% for reliable IDS stream reconstruction at 1Gbps.
